nodes.label: Excel-to-PDF Generation via LibreOffice Headless
nodes.rationale: openpyxl fills cells preserving formulas (e.g. D33 ='L7'); cross-sheet formulas (C23/F23) are overwritten with direct values before deleting other sheets so the exported PDF is self-contained; LibreOffice evaluates remaining formulas during conversion. HOME env var set to tmp dir for LibreOffice profile.

nodes.label: Full/Sencillo Threshold Logic (contenedor.length > 12)
nodes.rationale: Threshold changed from 32 to 12 chars in ManiobrasPage (FilaNueva and ModalEditar). >12 chars implies full (2 containers, enables Remolque 2); <=12 implies sencillo (1 container). Shared across both modals and the CTA Port backend view.
